checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is printed on page 1, the same page as the itemized prices, which counts as placed correctly.
The basic services includesText names the arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead-type fee, with no additional basic facilities or handling fee.
The embalming disclosure is printed on page 1, the same page as the $795 embalming price, which counts as placed correctly.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
The alternative-container disclosure is printed on page 2, the same page as the direct cremation range, which counts as placed correctly.
Direct cremation is offered with a purchaser-provided container and with fiberboard or wood-box alternatives, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions transportation to crematory and cremation, and the list shows no separate crematory cash-advance charge.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service appears only inside a description or policy.
The list offers no optional combination package; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that a specific purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory; the laws-or-cemetery-rules language is part of the reworded selection disclosure.
No text claims that a product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and rewording alone is not treated as altering a disclosure for this check.
